personaRemake.acting: A small ornate bronze brazier on three short legs appears on the floor beside her, on viewer-left, with a soft golden shimmer (it never pops in); a low warm fire already flickers in it. Holding her ONE brown book in her left arm, she slides ONE slim pale-blue booklet out of it with her right hand, flips it open and skims it with cool half-lidded eyes, then snaps it shut with a decisive clap. She throws it: a quick wind-up drawing her right arm back past her shoulder, then a sharp snap of the wrist that sends the booklet spinning in a short fast arc straight down into the brazier. The instant it lands the fire flares up in a big burst of layered hand-drawn anime flames, deep orange outside and bright gold inside, with curling grey smoke and a spray of sparks, then settles while the booklet blackens and crumbles into glowing embers. She brushes her fingertips together twice and lifts her chin with a faintly satisfied, "that is settled" look. Then the brazier and its fire fade away with a soft golden shimmer and she returns to her composed standing pose holding her brown book.
